Ehsaas · a feeling, kept
Some feelings need no words —
they simply become the language of the heart.
a quiet evening, home
In your presence,
every unspoken wish quietly comes true.
just as you are
You turned an ordinary blessing
into my favourite reason to believe in luck.
an afternoon, outdoors
Not everything sacred needs an altar —
some of it just needs your smile.
a glance, sideways
You became the answer
before I'd even finished asking the question.
an evening, quietly golden
Every horizon looks a little softer,
knowing I get to tell you about it later.
up in the hills
There isn't a bigger word for you —
just... mine.
a little red, a lot of you
for you, always
